criteria.SA_1_DECISION_GRANULARITY_MATCH: The competitor answers the same question the realized lead-in asks, at the same grain as the key.
criteria.SA_2_STEM_ANCHOR_PRESENT: At least one of the seed's frozen shared_features_with_key is instantiated by the realized stem. This is the G1 finding COMPETITOR_WITHOUT_STEM_ANCHOR turned into a check.
criteria.SA_3_CONTEXTUALLY_PLAUSIBLE: The competitor is realistically selectable for this patient, this severity and this setting, and does not instantiate a shortcut the bound discipline profile prohibits.

note: The stage exists because the retrieval index keys on discipline, item archetype and option-set archetype and not on the learner decision, so a seed curated for one decision is retrieved for any other decision sharing that triple. Every SA_1 refusal below is an instance of that.
